message.content: The decision to notify the supervisory authority is based on a medium severity score of 2.5 [F02][F05][F04]. This assessment was triggered because 1,200 records containing names, addresses, benefit types, and PESEL numbers were sent via unencrypted email to an unknown recipient [F03][F02][F05][F04]. Although the recipient has been identified and deletion confirmed [F06], the breach poses a medium risk to the rights and freedoms of the data subjects under GDPR Art. 33(1) [F02][F05][F04].
